name: qa-mods

plugins.name: sandbox-guard
plugins.description: Denies writes to protected Claude config paths and hands back a Terminal command

plugins.name: remote-gate
plugins.description: Asks before git push and wrangler --remote, showing the folder, the branch, the remote and the commits that will go out. Understands git -C dir and cd dir &&. Fail closed.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Shows what a risky Bash command will touch before it runs

plugins.name: retry-analyzer
plugins.description: Detects repeated identical failing tool calls and tells Claude to change strategy

plugins.name: secret-redactor
plugins.description: Masks tokens and keys in tool output

plugins.name: evidence-saver
plugins.description: Saves screenshots from tool results to a folder the user picks (asked once, remembered; /evidence-dir)

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay: step through the session's file edits one by one

plugins.name: verification-guard
plugins.description: Checks Claude's claims (tests pass, verified, fixed) against tool calls that actually ran; warns on unsupported ones; /evidence

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: From 80% of the context: a button (desktop), a hint line (terminal) or a hint after the answer (VS Code) offering /handoff, which puts a HANDOFF.md/CONTEXT.md prompt into the input box.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: A quick pop-up (toast, plus a macOS system notification) when a long Bash command or a long turn finishes, so you can stop watching it.

plugins.name: quick-actions
plugins.description: Compact and Clear buttons in the footer; each asks to confirm or cancel before it runs the slash command. In VS Code (no footer) the typed /compact and /clear ask first.

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: Rate-limit windows and session cost above the prompt, a prompt-cache countdown in the footer, and /hud with the same figures as text.

plugins.name: next-steps-uk
plugins.description: Fork of next-steps (MIT, Thariq Shihipar): suggested next prompts are always written in Ukrainian. Install INSTEAD of next-steps.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Fork of plan-progress 0.7.6 (zycck, MIT): live progress bars above the prompt, a wider title and the full title on hover. Install INSTEAD of plan-progress@zycck-mods.

description: QA mods pack: sandbox-guard, remote-gate, blast-radius, retry-analyzer, secret-redactor, evidence-saver, replay-theater, verification-guard, handoff, notify, quick-actions, hud, next-steps-uk, plan-progress (fork). Install all with install-pack.sh.
